description: Installation of new communications kiosk with integrated advertising display and defibrillator to replace existing Kiosk, plus associated Telephone kiosk removal.
decision_conditions: <p>The size, design, location, illumination and moving digital display of the proposed communications kiosk, results in an&nbsp; unnecessary distraction to drivers, contrary to highway safety. As such, the proposal would be contrary to policies and T2 (Healthy streets) and D8 (Public realm) of the London Plan (2021) and policies PP1 (Public Realm), LP7 (Advertisements), and LP41 (Liveable Neighbourhoods),&nbsp; and LP42 (Walking and Cycling) and LP43 (Transport and Development) of Hackney’s Local Development Plan LP33 (2020).&nbsp;</p>

<p><span id="docs-internal-guid-af3eed9d-7fff-3cb4-1036-e7de7d7383f1"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">The proposed communications kiosk, by reason of its size, scale, detailed design, appearance, and illumination, featuring a moving digital display, would result in an obtrusive and visually incongruous feature that contributes to an unsightly proliferation and clutter of signage and street furniture in the street scene that would detract from the visual amenities of the surrounding area and would have an adverse impact on the setting of the adjacent conservation area. As such, the proposal would be contrary to policies D3 (Optimising site capacity through the design-led approach), D4 (Delivering good design), D8 (Public realm), and HC1 (Heritage conservation and growth) of the London Plan (2021) and policies PP1 (Public Realm), LP1 (High Quality Design), LP3 (Designated Heritage Assets), and LP7 (Advertisements) of Hackney's Local Development Plan LP33 (2020), the </span><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">Public Realm Strategy SPD (2012) and the Commercial Extensions and Alterations SPD (2025).</span></span></p>
